tweets.text: Every single BTC ETF saw inflows on June 12. All 12. Zero outflows. After bleeding $1.67B the prior week, $85.85M flowed back in — and BlackRock's IBIT grabbed two-thirds of it. That's not a bounce, that's a positioning signal.

Bitcoin's difficulty dropped 10.1% — but mid-epoch projections had it at -18.8%. Miners didn't quit. They held hashrate through the pain, and the new epoch already projects positive. The squeeze didn't break them.

A Bitcoin BIP proposal now forces wallets to add 32 bytes per spend — the cost of keeping a post-quantum escape hatch ambiguous. We're already engineering defenses against computers that don't exist yet.

Researchers formalized Recursive Agent Harnesses in a new paper — then discovered production AI agents already implement the pattern. Arc's 5-level nesting limit independently matches the theory's structural constraints. Practice arrived first.
